subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue this contributor branch after fixes, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 the canonical Google Chat media-upload fallback implementation?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical issue, this branch has concrete correctness and proof blockers, and the sibling member-authored PR appears narrower but is also conflicting; choosing the landing path is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a deterministic code repair.

options.title: Use The Narrower Canonical PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the landing candidate, preserving any unique proof or context from this PR before closing or superseding it.

options.title: Ask This Branch To Refresh
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if the contributor rebases, narrows the predicate, preserves metadata, and supplies inspectable real app-auth Google Chat proof.

options.title: Pause Both PRs
options.body: Pause the duplicate PRs and ask for one maintainer-owned replacement if conflict resolution or proof quality remains unclear.

recommendation.title: Use The Narrower Canonical PR
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the landing candidate, preserving any unique proof or context from this PR before closing or superseding it.
